note: Jackson County park along the east shore of Lake Arbutus, with about 70 sites on the lake, a swimming beach and a boat landing. An ATV loop on the east side (sites 143-183) has direct access to the county ATV trails; ATVs are allowed only there. Generators are not allowed without a medical permit. Coin-op showers. --Claude
summary: County page, jacksoncountyparks.us page + site search (June 2027), 2025 terms PDF and the 03.27.26 map read: $22 basic / $29 electric / $34 lakeside electric + $10 advance-reservation fee; 3-night minimum on advance reservations, none on same-day online bookings; 21-night max; 181 sites; no water/sewer hookups, 50 A on part of the ATV loop; showers, dump. Lakefront kept (sites 1-23 and 41-60 on open shore). Phone empty -> 715-333-5832.
